name: Dot Communications
summary: Sydney dialup/ISDN + hosting + VISP wholesale ISP; pivoted to Viper ISP billing platform; later defunct (DOT COMMUNICATIONS PTY LIMITED, ACN 060 319 824).

events.details: Dialup/ISDN, hosting, VISP wholesale. Earliest Wayback capture 21 Dec 1996 (dot.net.au).

Retail ISP homepage last captured Jan 2001; dot.net.au began 302-redirecting in 2002 as the firm refocused on the Viper ISP billing platform. The domain was later reused for an unrelated site (live captures 2011-2025). Retail portal was live until 7 Apr 2004 and 302-redirecting to dot.com.au by 17 Apr 2004, so death is Apr 2004, not 2002.

refs.label: Own live JSP portal Nov 2003; identical digest still served 7 Apr 2004 — last live capture
Redirecting to dot.com.au from 17 Apr 2004 — transition occurred 7-17 Apr 2004
By Sep 2007 the site was Dot's Viper B2B wholesale platform — not a retail ISP
